essence: The opening presents the supreme means as the supreme word of the great lord.
The supreme greatness is mere light, with freedom as the only additional element distinguished.
All light-ness comes from one light, and the universe appears within it without separation.
The unbarred supreme lord reveals the whole spectacle of creation and destruction.
World activities appear distinctly and unmixed in one conscious lord, like reflections in a pure mirror.
